name: O-TA Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: O-TA Precision Industry Co., Ltd., a company based in Pingtung, Taiwan, primarily focuses on the manufacture, contract processing, assembly, and sale of golf club heads and their semi-finished components. Their product catalog features a variety of golf equipment, including metal woods, iron heads, CNC-machined putters, shafts, and complete club assemblies. Beyond its core golf business, O-TA has diversified its offerings. The company develops and markets bicycles under its proprietary VOLANDO brand and also supplies ALLTAS stainless steel faucets. Furthermore, O-TA Precision Industry extends its reach internationally, exporting products to major markets such as Japan and the United States. The company was established in 1988.
